summary: Added 15 missing CSS rule sets to styles.css for orchestrator widget classes referenced by WP-010, WP-011, and WP-013.

New rules: .section-title (h1 page heading), .btn-icon (icon button utility), .orchestrator-status-card/-header/-body/-elapsed/-pid/-progress-summary (status card from renderStatusCard), .orchestrator-kill-btn/.orchestrator-dismiss-btn (empty rules, visual handled by .btn-danger/.btn-secondary), .log-preview-entry (log entry in poll preview), .orchestrator-cli-reference and its h4/pre (CLI reference card), .orch-status-cell (queue table column), .orch-active-run-section (project detail active run), .orch-cli-kill-hint (CLI kill hint text).
Dark mode overrides added for orchestrator-status-card, orchestrator-cli-reference, and log-preview-entry.
All rules use existing CSS custom properties (--color-surface, --color-border, --color-text-muted, --radius, --font-mono) for theme consistency.
616 GUI tests pass, CSS braces balanced (358/358), no regressions.

summary: WP-014 PASS with one Fix-Forward applied. All 15 new CSS rule sets verified in styles.css covering every orchestrator widget class from WP-010/011/013. CSS variable usage is consistent throughout — --color-surface, --color-border, --color-text-muted, --radius, --font-mono. Empty rules for orchestrator-kill-btn/orchestrator-dismiss-btn are intentional and well-commented. One Fix-Forward applied: [data-theme="dark"] .log-preview-entry hardcoded `color: #9ca3af` (gray-400) instead of `color: var(--color-text-muted)` (#94a3b8 in dark mode) — changed to use the variable for design-system consistency. 616 GUI tests still pass after the fix.

comments.note: [Fix-Forward] styles.css line ~2455 — [data-theme="dark"] .log-preview-entry used hardcoded `color: #9ca3af` while the design system dark-mode variable `--color-text-muted` is `#94a3b8`. The base rule already uses `color: var(--color-text-muted)`, so the dark override was silently overwriting the CSS variable with a slightly different non-canonical value. Changed to `color: var(--color-text-muted)` for full design-system consistency. 616 GUI tests still pass.

The three [data-theme="dark"] overrides for .orchestrator-status-card and .orchestrator-cli-reference use `var(--color-surface)` and `var(--color-border)`, which are already theme-aware variables — making the overrides redundant but harmless. Future cleanup could remove them, but they cause no behavioral issue today.
